mission.goal: Operate a transactional EvidenceOps Heartbeat System for documented surfaces, participating chat turns, bidirectional response bundles, persistent adapter remediation and Kimmie Seed connector binding.
mission.user: Kim Kagiso Mosiane and governed EvidenceOps workflows
mission.workflow: index surfaces, ingest each supported turn, privacy-project, route capabilities, atomically commit node/outbox/receipt, return acknowledgement or assistance, reconcile stale nodes and adapter gaps, bind connector PRE/POST receipts
mission.data: SQLite transactional state, public-safe surface contracts, hashed private references, capability metadata, outbox response bundles, remediation cases and connector receipts
mission.interface: Python CLI, authenticated FastAPI endpoints, tool-only remote MCP tools, scheduler artifact and JSON contracts
mission.stack: Python 3.11+, SQLite, FastAPI, TypeScript MCP SDK, Cloud Run and GitHub Actions
mission.environment: Federation-Omega repository, private sovereign runtime, MCP adapter and supported ChatGPT turn adapters
mission.governance: Formation Engine, MODISA Code-Forge, zero-cost and single-effectful-path controls
mission.failure: fail closed on invalid input, missing evidence, insufficient proof, authority excess, safety regression or external effect without permit
mission.testing: unit, transaction, API authentication, privacy, replay, PRE/POST, TypeScript compile, scheduler, container and hosted round-trip gates
mission.deployment: merge to default branch, deploy private runtime and MCP adapter, bind identities and secrets, then prove one hosted turn and delivery round trip
mission.continuity: SQLite receipts, source fingerprints, immutable workflow artifacts, current manifest binding, idempotent event IDs and deterministic reruns

assumptions.runtime: repository checkout or GitHub-hosted Actions runner
assumptions.storage: SQLite for transaction state plus immutable GitHub artifacts for public-safe reports
assumptions.authentication: application-layer heartbeat bearer token plus Cloud Run service identity for private runtime ingress
assumptions.deployment: default-branch GitHub Actions, private Cloud Run runtime and remote MCP adapter

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: JSON and workflow-summary surfaces are sufficient
components.database: SQLite transactions for surfaces, chat nodes, turns, outbox, receipts, adapter cases and connector seeds
components.queue: transactional response outbox plus GitHub Actions scheduled queue with concurrency fencing
components.worker: FastAPI runtime, MCP adapter and Python heartbeat CLI in the existing scheduler job
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: every run hashes current source bytes
components.storage: repository contracts plus immutable workflow artifact
components.authentication: heartbeat token, Cloud Run service identity and separate Formation permit for provider effects

observability.correlation_ids: event_id, chat node hash, turn_id hash, sequence, message_id, seed_id and operation_id
observability.health_checks: surface index, authenticated ingress configuration, source status and current-turn canary
observability.structured_logs: canonical JSON heartbeat, reconciliation and connector receipts
observability.audit_logs: transaction receipts, response hashes, connector result hashes and per-source evidence hashes
observability.metrics_alerts: active/stale/sync-pending nodes, open adapter cases, outbox state, PRE/POST counts and degraded sources

testing.unit: registry validation, scoring, deduplication, safety and proof gates
testing.integration: all named systems attach to current_workflow.json; every documented surface receives a node and remediation case
testing.e2e_or_smoke: authenticated API commits a turn and same-response assistance; scheduler emits public-safe reports; MCP adapter compiles
testing.fixtures_mocks: temporary registries, evidence files and workflow contexts
testing.failure_first: path escape, missing evidence, replay, sequence gaps, expired nodes, unbound surfaces, unauthorised API use, POST without PRE, unsafe improvement and effect without permit

delivery.file_tree: capability_heartbeat package, sovereign runtime endpoints, MCP tools, scheduler/workflows and governing manifests
deploy_commands: Merge validated changes to default branch
Deploy private sovereign runtime with heartbeat token
Grant MCP runtime Cloud Run invoker
Deploy MCP adapter with runtime URL and heartbeat token
Run provider-backed turn and delivery readback
rollback_commands: Revert the heartbeat merge commit; existing scheduler remains independently usable
delivery.debugging: Inspect source status, held reasons, proof level, authority envelope, safety baseline and report hash; never inspect secret values

watchman.policy: hold unproven, unavailable, unsafe, non-zero-cost or over-authority candidates; never execute from discovery

continuity.idempotency: report content hash excludes generation time and binds repository version, source hashes and workflow contract
continuity.checkpoints: source heartbeat, routing decision, report hash and immutable workflow artifact
continuity.resume_conditions: rerun after source, workflow context, authority or proof state changes
continuity.stop_switch: remove scheduler heartbeat invocation and active-manifest heartbeat requirement

proof.test_results: 24 heartbeat unit/integration tests passed; 5 sovereign-runtime/API tests passed; MCP TypeScript no-emit compile passed
proof.semantic_verification: Local turn transaction, same-response acknowledgement/assistance, privacy projection, replay protection, adapter remediation and Kimmie PRE/POST behavior verified
known_activation_obligations: complete hosted CI and container canary
grant MCP runtime Cloud Run invoker
read back one hosted turn response and adapter delivery receipt
verify each provider adapter before changing its surface state to LIVE_BIDIRECTIONAL_VERIFIED
